Don Hummer Trucking is an American truckload carrier headquartered in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. It provides nationwide freight hauling, including dedicated freight services, dry van truckload, and temperature-controlled truckload transport. As of 2024, the company's drivers logged over 39 million miles.
History
Don Hummer Trucking traces its roots to the mid-20th century. Buck Hummer, Don Hummer's father, began hauling livestock in Oxford, Iowa, in 1951. Buck Hummer Trucking was incorporated in 1968.
Don Hummer, a second-generation trucker, established Don Hummer Trucking Corporation in 1975 and incorporated it in 1982 with four trucks. The company initially leased trucks to larger carriers. After obtaining its operating authority in 1987, it began acquiring smaller trucking operations.
In 1996, the Don Hummer Trucking logo was trademarked and remains in use today.
In 2012, a group of investors led by current President Chris Hummer acquired Lillibridge Transportation, Inc. (25 trucks at the time). It was rebranded LTI Delivers, Inc. in 2014, becoming a sister company focused on brokerage and specialized services. Key milestones include joining the Blockchain in Transport Alliance (2017) and honoring 10 of its professional truck drivers who’ve driven more than 1 million accident-free miles with the company. (2019)
Fleet and Technology
Don Hummer Trucking operates a modern fleet of 300Kenworth, Volvo, and Freightliner tractors and more than 875 trailers, including 53-foot food-grade dry vans equipped with air-ride suspension, low-rolling-resistance tires, and aerodynamic devices. The entire fleet is CARB compliant.

Awards and Recognition
* Spirit of Excellence Award – Hormel Foods (2013, 2017, 2018)
* Best Trucking Company – Corridor Business Journal (2019, 2021, 2023, 2024, 2025)
* Central Region Carrier of the Year – PepsiCo (2024)
* Truckload Carrier of the Year – HNI (2024)
* Critical Problem-Solving Carrier – Pella Corporation (2024)
* Elite Fleet Certification – Truckload Carriers Association (2025)
Philanthropy
The company has supported community and veteran initiatives, including volunteering equipment for The Wall That Heals (Vietnam Veterans Memorial Fund, 2018) , donating a tractor-trailer rig to Hawkeye Community College for CDL training (2022) , and recognition in the Wreaths Across America Honor Fleet (2025).
